description.zh-TW: 設定值只用於這次活動。
description.en: These values apply only to this session.

description.zh-TW: 0＝隨機；1–3＝固定文章，可控制材料差異；重複有熟悉效應。編號依各語言素材檔名排序，不代表難度。
description.en: 0 = random; 1–3 = fixed passage. Repetitions introduce familiarity. IDs follow sorted filenames within each language, not difficulty ranks.

description.zh-TW: 每分鐘呈現的故事文字片段數；此為刺激速度，不是實測閱讀速度。
description.en: Story tokens presented per minute; this is a stimulus rate, not measured reading speed.

description.zh-TW: 100＝每批 1 段，200＝2 段，依此類推；文字片段由故事分詞決定，並非標準化擁擠效應測量。
description.en: 100 = 1 token, 200 = 2 tokens, and so on. Tokens follow story segmentation; this does not measure a standardized crowding effect.

description.zh-TW: 百分比先轉成插件的對数參數；較大代表文字較深。這是顯示灰階控制值，未做螢幕亮度校正。
description.en: Percent is converted to the plugin logarithmic parameter; larger values darken text. This controls display gray level without luminance calibration.
